description: This file contains OAuth-related functions and type definitions for the Chutes API, including PKCE generation, OAuth callback parsing, token exchange, user info fetching, and token refreshing.

methods.name: generateChutesPkce
methods.description: Generates a PKCE verifier and challenge pair for OAuth flow.

methods.name: parseOAuthCallbackInput
methods.description: Parses OAuth callback URL or string to extract code and state, validating CSRF protection.

methods.name: fetchChutesUserInfo
methods.description: Fetches user info from Chutes API using an access token.

methods.name: exchangeChutesCodeForTokens
methods.description: Exchanges an authorization code for access and refresh tokens, and fetches user info.

methods.name: refreshChutesTokens
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth tokens using a stored refresh token.
